title: Local Food and Family Farm Prosperity
research_question: Can locally rooted family farm systems supported by regional processing, institutional purchasing, regenerative stewardship, and cooperative infrastructure create broader and more durable community prosperity than comparable conventional systems under identifiable conditions?
hypothesis: Guaranteed institutional local markets, shared Food Utility infrastructure, and stewardship pay can make family farms engines of community wealth without micromanaging production.
